title: The Midnight Market
description: A market that is only there between two and four in the morning,
down the alley that is only an alley when you are not looking at
it, run by a vendor class the province denies the existence of
and patronised by everybody in it.
This group starts collapsed in the sidebar -- `collapsedByDefault`,
on the group manifest, which is what a group of secrets asks for --
and it is the collection's exhibit of the hiding family and the
dice: one quest hidden until it is stumbled onto, one hidden until
its prerequisite rule is met, one that withholds its details until
it can be started, a crossroads that closes two of its three roads
for good, a stall operating under a name it no longer uses -- an
alias, with a dependency written against the old name -- and
rewards thrown for: a `random` roll that promises something, a
`loot` roll with an `emptyWeight` that can disappoint, a nested
table inside a table, and an inline version of the same.
The chapter wears `obsidian` with a `themePatch` over it -- one
colour and a corner radius of its own -- which makes it the
collection's themed chapter outside the descent, and the ghost
road in is drawn dotted, because the market's roads are rumours.
Read it for: the whole hiding family, `maxCompletableDependents`,
a quest alias with a dependency on it, `tasked:loot` and its
`emptyWeight`, nested and inline tables, `themePatch`, a chapter
theme outside the descent, and a `collapsedByDefault` group.
